== Summary ==
Identified: none. The player in a landscape trucker cap, a grey quarter-zip, and tattoos is the same man as [[:File:2022 Endor Grand Prix 7.jpg]] and the Deadpool-shirt player in [[:File:2022 Endor Grand Prix 57.jpg]]. The player in a brown blazer is the same man as [[:File:2022 Endor Grand Prix 7.jpg]]. Faces unlabeled.
